---
title: "Model-iteration-6 (lean)"
format: html
---

Model 6: a lean feature set. One column per idea, no redundant forms of the same information,
and no groups that the ablation or the paired tests showed to add nothing.
Same hyperparameters, grouped CV and chronological cutoff as Models 3 to 5.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(xgboost)
library(yardstick)
library(shapviz)
library(here)
```

Read data, keep innings 1 and 2

```{r}
target_col <- "wickets"

bbl_inn <- readRDS(here("Pranav", "data", "bbl_t20_data.rds")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(innings %in% c(1, 2))
```

Chronological cutoff, identical to Models 3 to 5. League priors use training matches only.

```{r}
match_dates <- bbl_inn |>
  filter(shortened_match == 0) |>
  distinct(match_id, start_date) |>
  arrange(start_date, match_id)

cutoff_index <- floor(nrow(match_dates) * 0.8)
cutoff_date  <- match_dates$start_date[cutoff_index]

train_match_ids <- match_dates |> filter(start_date <= cutoff_date) |> pull(match_id)
match_lookup    <- bbl_inn |> distinct(match_id, start_date)
```

Player-identity features : shrunk, lagged batter dismissal rate and bowler wicket rate

```{r}
K_bat  <- 120
K_bowl <- 150

bat_faced <- bbl_inn |>
  group_by(match_id, striker) |>
  summarise(balls = sum(ifelse(is.na(wides), 1, 0)), .groups = "drop")

bat_out <- bbl_inn |>
  filter(wickets == 1, !is.na(player_dismissed)) |>
  group_by(match_id, striker = player_dismissed) |>
  summarise(dism = n(), .groups = "drop")

bat_match <- full_join(bat_faced, bat_out, by = c("match_id", "striker")) |>
  left_join(match_lookup, by = "match_id") |>
  mutate(balls = coalesce(balls, 0), dism = coalesce(dism, 0))

league_bat <- bat_match |> filter(match_id %in% train_match_ids) |>
  summarise(r = sum(dism) / sum(balls)) |> pull(r)

bat_rate <- bat_match |>
  arrange(striker, start_date, match_id) |>
  group_by(striker) |>
  mutate(b = lag(cumsum(balls), default = 0),
         d = lag(cumsum(dism),  default = 0),
         sk_bat_dismissal_rate = (d + K_bat * league_bat) / (b + K_bat)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(match_id, striker, sk_bat_dismissal_rate)

bowl_match <- bbl_inn |>
  group_by(match_id, start_date, bowler) |>
  summarise(balls = sum(legal_ball), wkts = sum(bowler_wicket), .groups = "drop")

league_bowl <- bowl_match |> filter(match_id %in% train_match_ids) |>
  summarise(r = sum(wkts) / sum(balls)) |> pull(r)

bowl_rate <- bowl_match |>
  arrange(bowler, start_date, match_id) |>
  group_by(bowler) |>
  mutate(b = lag(cumsum(balls), default = 0),
         w = lag(cumsum(wkts),  default = 0),
         sk_bowl_wicket_rate = (w + K_bowl * league_bowl) / (b + K_bowl)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(match_id, bowler, sk_bowl_wicket_rate)

n0 <- nrow(bbl_inn)

bbl_all <- bbl_inn |>
  left_join(bat_rate,  by = c("match_id", "striker")) |>
  left_join(bowl_rate, by = c("match_id", "bowler"))

stopifnot(nrow(bbl_all) == n0)

bbl_all <- bbl_all |> filter(shortened_match == 0)
```

The lean feature set 

```{r}
stage_cols  <- c("innings", "balls_remaining", "wickets_lost_before",
                 "score_before", "required_rr", "free_hit")

batter_cols <- c("sk_bat_dismissal_rate", "career_matches_before",
                 "career_boundary_p_before", "batsman_balls_faced_before",
                 "batsman_strike_rate_before")

bowler_cols <- c("sk_bowl_wicket_rate", "career_economy_before")

feature_cols <- c(stage_cols, batter_cols, bowler_cols)
length(feature_cols)
```

Select and split (same cutoff as before)

```{r}
model_data <- bbl_all |>
  select(match_id, start_date, all_of(feature_cols), all_of(target_col))

train_data <- model_data |> filter(start_date <= cutoff_date)
test_data  <- model_data |> filter(start_date >  cutoff_date)

y_train <- train_data[[target_col]]
y_test  <- test_data[[target_col]]

x_train <- train_data |> select(all_of(feature_cols)) |> as.matrix()
x_test  <- test_data  |> select(all_of(feature_cols)) |> as.matrix()

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test,  label = y_test)

c(train_rows = nrow(train_data), test_rows = nrow(test_data),
  base_rate_train = mean(y_train), base_rate_test = mean(y_test))

# Missingness in the lean set (NA is expected for required_rr in innings 1)
train_data |> summarise(across(all_of(feature_cols), ~ mean(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "col", values_to = "prop_na") |>
  filter(prop_na > 0)
```

Evaluation helper, parameters (same as Model 2) and grouped 5-fold CV

```{r}
eval_preds <- function(truth, p) {
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, 1e-15), 1 - 1e-15)
  tibble(
    pr_auc  = pr_auc_vec(factor(truth, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second"),
    roc_auc = roc_auc_vec(factor(truth, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second"),
    logloss = -mean(truth * log(p) + (1 - truth) * log(1 - p)),
    brier   = mean((p - truth)^2)
  )
}

params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "aucpr",
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 5
)

set.seed(35571381)

train_matches <- unique(train_data$match_id)
fold_of_match <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out = length(train_matches)))
folds <- lapply(1:5, function(k) {
  which(train_data$match_id %in% train_matches[fold_of_match == k])
})

t20_cv <- xgb.cv(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 1000,
  folds = folds,
  early_stopping_rounds = 25,
  print_every_n = 25,
  maximize = TRUE
)

best_nrounds <- t20_cv$evaluation_log$iter[
  which.max(t20_cv$evaluation_log$test_aucpr_mean)
]
best_nrounds
```

Final model and test evaluation

```{r}
t20_final <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = best_nrounds,
  evals = list(train = dtrain),
  print_every_n = 50
)

pred_probs <- predict(t20_final, dtest)

m4 <- readRDS(here("Pranav", "data", "model_4_results.rds"))
stopifnot(identical(as.numeric(m4$y_test), as.numeric(y_test)))   # same test rows

results <- bind_rows(
  base_rate = eval_preds(y_test, rep(mean(y_train), length(y_test))),
  model_4   = eval_preds(y_test, m4$pred_probs),
  model_6   = eval_preds(y_test, pred_probs),
  .id = "model"
)
results
```

Bootstrap CIs (whole matches resampled): the lean model on its own, and its paired difference from Model 4.
A difference interval that includes zero means the lean model loses nothing detectable.

```{r}
set.seed(35571381)

idx_by_match <- split(seq_len(nrow(test_data)), test_data$match_id)

boot <- map_dfr(1:200, function(i) {
  m   <- sample(names(idx_by_match), replace = TRUE)
  idx <- unlist(idx_by_match[m], use.names = FALSE)
  a <- eval_preds(y_test[idx], pred_probs[idx])
  b <- eval_preds(y_test[idx], m4$pred_probs[idx])
  tibble(m6_pr = a$pr_auc, m6_roc = a$roc_auc,
         pr_diff_vs_m4 = a$pr_auc - b$pr_auc, roc_diff_vs_m4 = a$roc_auc - b$roc_auc)
})

boot |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metric") |>
  group_by(metric) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(value),
            lo = quantile(value, 0.025),
            hi = quantile(value, 0.975), .groups = "drop")
```

Calibration

```{r}
calibration <- tibble(pred = pred_probs, actual = y_test) |>
  mutate(bucket = ntile(pred, 10)) |>
  group_by(bucket) |>
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(pred), mean_actual = mean(actual), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
calibration
```

Permutation importance, by group and by feature (drop in test PR-AUC when the columns are shuffled)

```{r}
y_f <- factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1))
base_pr <- pr_auc_vec(y_f, pred_probs, event_level = "second")

perm_drop <- function(cols, n_rep = 5) {
  drops <- map_dbl(1:n_rep, function(r) {
    Xp <- x_test
    Xp[, cols] <- x_test[sample(nrow(x_test)), cols, drop = FALSE]   # shuffle jointly
    base_pr - pr_auc_vec(y_f, predict(t20_final, xgb.DMatrix(Xp)), event_level = "second")
  })
  tibble(pr_auc_drop = mean(drops), sd = sd(drops))
}

set.seed(35571381)

groups <- list(stage_of_innings = stage_cols, batter = batter_cols, bowler = bowler_cols)

perm_groups <- imap_dfr(groups, ~ perm_drop(.x) |> mutate(group = .y)) |>
  arrange(desc(pr_auc_drop))
perm_features <- map_dfr(feature_cols, ~ perm_drop(.x) |> mutate(feature = .x)) |>
  arrange(desc(pr_auc_drop))

perm_groups
perm_features
```

SHAP explanations (values are in log-odds)

```{r}
set.seed(35571381)
samp <- test_data |> slice_sample(n = 5000)
X    <- samp |> select(all_of(feature_cols)) |> as.matrix()

contrib <- predict(t20_final, X, predcontrib = TRUE)
stopifnot(ncol(contrib) == length(feature_cols) + 1)   # features + bias

S  <- contrib[, seq_along(feature_cols), drop = FALSE]
colnames(S) <- feature_cols
sv <- shapviz(S, X = as.data.frame(X), baseline = contrib[1, ncol(contrib)])

# 1. Which features push wicket risk up or down
sv_importance(sv, kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 13)

# 2. Where the signal comes from, by group
imap_dfr(groups, ~ tibble(group = .y,
                          mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(rowSums(S[, .x, drop = FALSE]))))) |>
  ggplot(aes(reorder(group, mean_abs_shap), mean_abs_shap)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean |SHAP| (log-odds)",
       title = "Where the model's wicket signal comes from")

# 3. Shape of the effects
sv_dependence(sv, "balls_remaining", color_var = "wickets_lost_before")
sv_dependence(sv, "batsman_balls_faced_before", color_var = "balls_remaining")

# 4. One delivery explained: the highest-risk ball in the sample
i <- which.max(rowSums(S))
sv_waterfall(sv, row_id = i, max_display = 10)

# 5. Average predicted wicket probability by over and wickets lost
test_data |>
  mutate(pred = pred_probs,
         over  = (120 - balls_remaining) %/% 6 + 1) |>
  filter(wickets_lost_before <= 8) |>
  group_by(over, wickets_lost_before) |>
  summarise(pred = mean(pred), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(over, wickets_lost_before, fill = pred)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Over", y = "Wickets lost", fill = "P(wicket)")
```

Save

```{r}
saveRDS(
  list(model = t20_final, cv = t20_cv, params = params, feature_cols = feature_cols,
       results = results, boot = boot, calibration = calibration,
       perm_groups = perm_groups, perm_features = perm_features,
       pred_probs = pred_probs, y_test = y_test, test_data = test_data),
  here("Pranav", "data", "model_6_results.rds")
)
```
